gloss: scrape, shaping tool, cassia; corner, set in corners
summary:
A priest orders a house scraped, and a woodworker uses tools of a related name to shape an image. The spice name occurs among the perfumes of a king’s garments.

The noun marks the angle where sides meet in a structure, including a city wall. Ezekiel uses a related passive form of the four small courts at the corners of the outer court.

senses.definition: To have the surface layer removed from the inside of a house.

evidence.note: After the affected stones are taken out, the priest orders the interior scraped all around. The loosened plaster is carried outside the city.

senses.definition: Situated at the corners of a larger enclosure.

evidence.note: The description gives the same dimensions for all four courts just located at the corners.

senses.definition: A tool with which a craftsperson shapes wood to a marked outline.

evidence.note: The carpenter stretches a line, marks out the figure and works it with these tools until it resembles a person.

senses.definition: An aromatic bark used as a perfume.

evidence.note: Cassia is named with myrrh and aloes in the description of the king’s fragrant garments.

senses.definition: A place where sides meet or a wall changes direction.

evidence.note: The two paired frames are joined at the two corners of the dwelling.
Baruch’s section of wall starts at the angle and runs to the entrance of Eliashib’s house.
Ezekiel finds a smaller court in each of the four corners of the outer court.

evidence.locator: S01829, Pael, Zevahim 94a on trimming a hide
S01818, Targum Exodus 30:24 and Targum Psalms 45:9

note:
The psalm establishes the scent. Aramaic supplies the identification as cassia. A derivation from scraping bark is possible, though the verse describes the scented garments alone. Isaiah leaves the precise shape of the carpenter’s tool open.

The four-court arrangement gives the passive form its probable meaning. Its only occurrence is the final word of Ezekiel 46:22. A historical connection between the architectural and scraping terms remains uncertain.
